## Extension: BssBillingAccount

Every billingAccount body carries `@type: BssBillingAccount`, `@baseType: BillingAccount` and `@schemaLocation` pointing at the schema below, served by `GET /tmf-api/schema/BssBillingAccount.schema.json` (`app/api/account.py`). Tests validate every full billingAccount body against both TMF666 and this schema (`tests/apiclient.py`).

```json
{
  "$id": "/tmf-api/schema/BssBillingAccount.schema.json",
  "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#",
  "description": "Extension of the TMF666 BillingAccount: the attributes this service adds. An instance must also satisfy the TMF666 v5 BillingAccount schema.",
  "properties": {
    "@baseType": {
      "const": "BillingAccount"
    },
    "@type": {
      "const": "BssBillingAccount"
    },
    "billCycleDay": {
      "description": "Day of month on which the account's billing period starts.",
      "maximum": 28,
      "minimum": 1,
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "currency": {
      "description": "ISO 4217 code of the account's single currency. Immutable.",
      "pattern": "^[A-Z]{3}$",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "@type",
    "@baseType",
    "billCycleDay",
    "currency"
  ],
  "title": "BssBillingAccount",
  "type": "object"
}
```

## Behaviour and deviations

| Rule | Code | Proven by |
|---|---|---|
| Responses are the extension `BssBillingAccount` (above): `billCycleDay` (1..28) and `currency` (ISO 4217) are required on create. TMF666 has no currency attribute, and `billStructure.cycleSpecification.billingDateShift` is an offset of the bill date, not the day a period starts - hence the extension | `app/api/account.py` | `tests/test_api_parties.py::test_billing_account_with_extension_and_balance`, `::test_the_extension_schema_is_served_and_valid`, `::test_the_client_checks_the_extension_schema` |
| `currency` is read-only (PATCH 400); `billCycleDay` is fixed for now (PATCH 409 with the reason - how a change treats the current period is an open question) | `patch_account` | `tests/test_api_parties.py::test_billing_account_patch` |
| Exactly one `relatedParty`: the customer, as a `PartyRoleRef` with `role: customer`; must exist (422); read-only | `AccountCreate`, `account_body` | `::test_billing_account_needs_one_existing_customer` |
| `state` is ours: `Active` (default), `Suspended`, `Closed`. Ordering refuses a non-Active account; billing does not look at it | `AccountState` | `tests/test_api_ordering.py::test_account_must_be_active_and_start_not_in_the_past` |
| **Balance** is `accountBalance[]` with exactly one read-only entry `{balanceType: currentBalance, amount}`, computed on every read as payments (`done`) minus all ABRs. Positive = the customer is in credit. `accountBalance` in a POST or PATCH is a 400 | `account_body`, `app/repository/billing.py` (`account_balance`) | `tests/test_api_parties.py::test_balance_is_payments_minus_charges_positive_means_credit`, `tests/test_api_inventory_bill.py::test_balance_includes_charges` |
| `creditLimit` (TMF666's own Money): in the account's currency (another unit is a 422), never negative (422), optional, PATCH `null` removes it. **Informational only**: nothing, ordering included, is ever refused because of it | `_credit_limit` | `tests/test_api_credit_limit_and_code.py::test_credit_limit_is_stored_returned_changed_and_removed`, `::test_invalid_credit_limits`, `::test_the_credit_limit_never_blocks_an_order` |
| `opened_at` (not exposed) is set from the injected clock at creation: it decides which billing runs include the account | `create_account` | `tests/test_api_parties.py::test_billing_account_opened_at_comes_from_the_injected_clock` |
| PATCH accepts `@type` `BssBillingAccount` or `BillingAccount` | `check_type` | `tests/test_api_parties.py::test_billing_account_patch` |

## Errors

Every non-2xx body is the TMF630 `Error`: `{"@type": "Error", "code", "reason", "message", "status"}` (`app/api/errors.py`), also for unknown routes, FastAPI's own validation errors and unhandled exceptions (500 says "internal error" only). Status codes: 400 malformed JSON, unknown or read-only attribute, bad query parameter; 404 unknown id or path; 405 unsupported method; 409 conflict with stored state; 415 wrong content type; 422 well-formed but invalid. 415 and 422 are ours: the TMF specs do not declare them. See [README.md](README.md#conventions).
